Headbang recorder

Records head movement with the phone's motion sensors. A voice counts down from 10, the music starts on "Go!", and the results are emailed to the team.

Researcher settings

On iPhone: open this page in Safari, turn off silent mode, turn the volume all the way up, and tap Allow when the page asks for motion access.

Waiting for motion data…

Strap the phone on the participant's head (upright, screen facing out), then tap Start. Recording starts right away, a voice counts down from 10, and the music starts on "Go!".
